name: Ten-Tails
description: (Tag:massive-size)A primordial god of pure natural energy embodying all early life, indistinguishable from the environment to sensing. Mountain-dwarfing in size yet faster than sound, with immense physical prowess. It endlessly fires country-annihilating Bijuu Bombs and world-spanning disasters, and as a Tailed Beast it is immortal, revives after death, and can fuse with a person to grant its powers.
